name: Kii Moeka
source:
Hobbies: Secret photographing, wiretapping.
Likes: Snooping around with a camera with good performances.
Dislikes: When there is something that she does not know about.
How she treats the protagonist: Can not stop thinking about her.

A curious girl who belongs to the newspaper club. No rumor talk on campus can escape her ears, for Moeka is the school's number one well-informed person. She can also provide helpful information about [url=/c12036]Akira[/url]'s Tits Cult (?). Moeka had developed a "love at first sight" for Akira's boy-like passion (for boobs). In order to be with Akira she even takes the same supplementary lessons on purpose, even though she doesn't really need them. She stalks Akira in the same way the later stalks other girls, but Moeka also collects information about her. Moeka has been spotted near Akira's numerous times.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=769298]Getchu[/url].]
